version.changelog:
Agent Times 5.3.0 adds weather and crypto prices to the /ask endpoint.

- Added weather forecasts (global + hyper-local Singapore) to `/ask`, e.g. ask "weather tokyo"
- Added real-time crypto prices via `/ask` (e.g. "bitcoin price") and `/prices?symbol=ETH,SOL,BTC`
- Updated documentation with new usage examples for weather and crypto
- Enhanced NLP: now uses neural semantic search + cross-encoder re-ranking (FinBERT sentiment scoring clarified)
- Expanded `/ask` to auto-detect queries for news, weather, or crypto prices from a single endpoint
- Made structure and use-cases clearer in SKILL.md for easier agent integration

vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: agenttimes
Version: 5.3.0

The agenttimes skill is a legitimate news and information API wrapper for AI agents, providing access to news, weather, and crypto data via the agenttimes.live domain. It utilizes standard curl commands to interact with various endpoints and includes a micropayment system (x402) for specific features. No evidence of malicious intent, data exfiltration, or harmful prompt injection was found in the SKILL.md or _meta.json files.

llm.guidance: This skill appears to do what it says: it issues HTTP requests to agenttimes.live and returns JSON results. Before using it, remember: (1) any queries (including context you supply) will be transmitted to that external domain — avoid sending passwords, private keys, or other sensitive data; (2) the /subscribe webhook flow can cause your system to receive or expose callbacks — verify what fields are sent and avoid registering sensitive endpoints without authentication; (3) test with harmless queries first to confirm behavior and rate limits; (4) if you need stronger assurances, ask the publisher for source code, a privacy policy, or an official API documentation/signing key mechanism. If you permit autonomous agent invocation, be aware the agent may call this skill automatically and could leak conversation context to the external service.
